title: Stacking with a scikit-learn Pipeline on pandas DataFrames
why: pandas DataFrames feeding scikit-learn Pipelines and ColumnTransformers are the everyday modelling stack of most data science teams.
notes: 32 live questions answered by every peer (ml, base_rate, persistence), replayed walk-forward with a two-day outcome lag; refitted each batch day.
limits: Only a few live days: the stacker has little to learn from; intervals are wide.
A mechanism check of the DataFrame stack, not a proposal for a new forecaster.
